rules.reason: The ordinary Linux/ARM64 corpus is built without AddressSanitizer instrumentation.
The ordinary Linux/ARM64 corpus is built without MemorySanitizer instrumentation.
The ordinary Linux/ARM64 corpus is built without race instrumentation.
The ordinary Linux/ARM64 corpus is built without Valgrind integration.
Specialized allocation entry points must be exercised by generated Go allocation shapes.
Runtime pinning backs supported public APIs and needs direct semantic coverage.
Runtime diagnostic logging is required on unusual failure and debugging paths.
Heap dump support is an explicit diagnostic path that needs a subprocess test.
Profiling buffer behavior requires explicit profiling and overflow tests.
Runtime tracing requires explicit start, stop, drain, and parseability tests.
Runtime trace buffer transitions require explicit tracing stress tests.
Runtime-generated trace events require explicit scheduler and GC tracing tests.
